## Summary

`src/bos/domain/s_curve/svg_generator.ts` interpolates `labelText` (line 177-178: `` `${m.year}: ${m.label}` ``), `sCurve.technologyName` (lines 214, 256, 258, 325), and `sCurve.performanceMetric` (line 212) into SVG markup with **no XML escaping anywhere** in `generate()` (verified: no `escapeXml`/`escape` helper exists in the file).

Labels and technology names come from AI extraction of web-search results and model output (`ai_data_extractor` / `triz_s_curve` tool args) — i.e. untrusted data. The SVGs are persisted to `02_TRL` via `PhaseWriter` and can be opened in a browser, where `<script>` inside SVG executes.

## Repro

```
triz_s_curve analyze with technologyName = "</text><script>alert(1)</script>"
```
→ generated SVG contains a live `<script>` element.

## Fix

Add an `escapeXml()` helper (`& < > " '`) and apply it to every interpolated text node in `generate()` and the markdown fallback.
title: SECURITY: stored XSS via unescaped labels in generated S-curve SVGs (svg_generator.ts)
